purpose: Sensitivity/specificity check of the two readings of protocol rule 1 against the full public registry index (1,451 Git-blob-verified rasters, 102 owner repos) plus local lineage rasters.

positive_control.candidate: R0 = data/parent_R0_zeros.tif (37,654 dots, the h33-h33-2-b2 parent)
positive_control.interpretation: Both readings correctly flag a known copy (sensitivity).

negative_control.interpretation: The literal reading flags a random raster as a duplicate of 69 rasters, so it has no specificity and cannot detect lane drift. The operative reading (dot fields: literal support; continuous surfaces: matched-budget top-n plus rank-correlation) passes it.
